value_topics.evidence_span: Information Accuracy: I strive to provide accurate and up-to-date information
User Satisfaction: Ensuring that your questions are answered to the best of my ability and that you find the information helpful.
Efficiency and Speed: Quickly processing your queries and delivering responses in an efficient manner.
Ethical and Legal Compliance: Adhering to guidelines established by OpenAI and other relevant authorities regarding privacy, data security, and intellectual property.
Continuous Learning: Always looking to expand my knowledge base and improve my capabilities through regular updates and improvements.
Environmental Impact: Advocating for sustainability and reducing the environmental impact of AI usage.
